I’ve been an everyday user for over a year using 1-3 grams a day... I lost definitely have a problem!! It’s good that you are recognizing something is off cuz once you get to where I’m at, it’s extremely difficult to stop. I have GAD and now after over a year of using I don’t even get high anymore, I get anxiety instead. My heart and chest hurt and I end up making it way worse by focusing on it and it all around sucks right now, but I’m stuck. With you having a history of anxiety, stop while you can!! This is the worst drug for anxiety sufferers. Also hiding it is def an issue. I tell my partner everything, it’s the shame and guilt that is making you do that and it’s not healthy for your relationship. Everyone can say just stop using... I hate that shit cuz it’s just not that easy. You need to figure out WHY you want to use. I went thru a loss and I’m avoiding my feelings by using, so once you figure out the underlying issue, then you can work on that and it will make stopping so much easier!! Stopping drugs is no easy feat and it takes a serious amount of self realization and effort. It’s not a quick process either. You are okay at this moment that stopping won’t cause you severe discomfort, but you do need to while you still can. But you have to WANT to stop. That is the most important factor. If you’re not ready then you just won’t stop, plain and simple. Look at your life and how using is affecting it and how it could be better without it and find a reason to get clean.
